summary: Durable supplier allowance outbox, bounded one-order operator and actual-CNY receipt validation implemented and independently reviewed locally.
limitations: Generated migration is not applied to production. Supabase CLI project list returned authentication unavailable; no login or reset attempted.
No live activation, customer email, charge, refund or inference performed.
Accepted exact native customer/package/quota/code mapping and fresh server secrets are required.
Inference credential must be proven to spend the mapped native customer allowance.
Supplier debit reader remains unconfigured until an authoritative native-CNY receipt contract is supplied.
PGlite checks use one in-memory connection; independent-connection production concurrency is not certified.
Refunds after possible grant suspend API WILD and require native reconciliation; no unsupported supplier revocation API is invented.
